title: Yellow Molten Saudi Arabian Egg Tagine
description: A briny, molten, and cozy Saudi-Arabian dish featuring egg, cooked in a tagine with aromatic spices, perfect for a low-carb meal. This recipe is a twist on traditional tagine cooking, with a rich and savory flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Make 4 wells in the onion mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the tagine or skillet with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.
Remove the tagine or skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Serve the eggs and sauce hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
